entries.title: Sai Nitish Reddy Kapa
entries.text: Sai Nitish Reddy Kapa presents himself on this portfolio as a communications and data professional, AI governance communicator, digital content strategist, and data analyst. His tagline is: Making complex technology clear, useful, and trustworthy.

entries.title: Professional focus
entries.text: The portfolio says Nitish has 3+ years of experience producing reports, presentations, digital content, dashboards, and stakeholder updates, combining editorial judgment, publication coordination, analytics, visual storytelling, and responsible AI tools.

entries.title: Areas of interest
entries.text: The portfolio highlights responsible AI, AI governance, technology policy, digital publishing, research communications, analytics, and mission-driven organizations working to make consequential systems safer and more accountable.

entries.title: Working principles
entries.text: Nitish's portfolio describes five working principles: understand before simplifying, design for the audience, make workflows reliable, measure and improve, and use AI responsibly with human review, factual verification, privacy, and accountability.

entries.title: Siraba HQ
entries.text: Siraba HQ is a featured in-development AI-powered company operating system for accepting work, routing it to specialized agents, storing organizational knowledge, managing approvals, and tracking artifacts across product, marketing, engineering, and operations. Nitish's role is listed as product design, system architecture, agent orchestration, and data modeling.

entries.title: Vakya
entries.text: Vakya is a featured in-development real-time language intelligence and accessibility platform for live speech, subtitles, documents, and multilingual communication. The portfolio lists live speech recognition, real-time translation, subtitle overlays, text-to-speech, browser and mobile experiences, and local or hosted processing modes.

entries.title: Keeply project
entries.text: The portfolio currently lists Keeply as a prototype personal knowledge and organization project: a universal place to capture links, screenshots, notes, files, ideas, and temporary information, with intelligent background organization and retrieval.

entries.title: Un-em
entries.text: Un-em is a featured prototype AI writing assistant designed for natural readable responses, explicit style controls, natural rewriting, a no-em-dash response mode, document generation, and adaptation to a chosen voice.

entries.title: Smriti.ai
entries.text: Smriti.ai is a featured research and prototype project described as a consent-focused private memorial conversation experience built from user-provided memories, messages, documents, and voice recordings, with local-first processing, explicit consent, privacy by design, user-controlled deletion, and clear emotional and ethical boundaries.

entries.title: Receipts
entries.text: Receipts is a featured MVP for local-first personal clarity and decision support. It helps users record decisions and reasoning, create calm scripts for difficult moments, save drafts, set review reminders and personal rules, and export or import their data.

entries.title: Contact
entries.text: The portfolio lists kapasainitishreddy@gmail.com as Nitish's contact email and links to his GitHub profile at github.com/kapasainitishreddy and LinkedIn profile at linkedin.com/in/kapasainitishreddy.
